name_zh: 日本醫療器材品質管理法規

4.1.rationale_en: The text states that PMDA investigates whether manufacturers have a QMS (Quality Management System) in place to ensure appropriate quality products are manufactured. This aligns with the general requirement of establishing, implementing, maintaining and continually improving a QMS as per ISO 13485:2016 clause 4.1.
4.1.rationale_zh: 文本指出，PMDA 将调查制造商是否已建立质量管理体系 (QMS)，以确保生产出适当质量的产品。这与根据 ISO 13485：2016 第 4.1 条建立、实施、维护和持续改进 QMS 的一般要求一致。
4.1.original_text: PMDAが調査しています。QMS適合性調査の申請に当たって提出すべき資料のうち、実地／書面調査の判定のために提出する資料については、その一部でも添付されていない場合は実地／書面の判定ができず、調査の開始が大きく遅れることになります
4.1.english_translation: PMDA investigates whether manufacturers have a QMS (Quality Management System) in place to ensure appropriate quality products are manufactured. If any of the documents submitted for the actual/documentary assessment are missing, the assessment cannot be performed and the investigation will be significantly delayed.
4.1.semantic_note: Focuses on verification of QMS existence rather than detailed requirements.

7.2.2.rationale_en: The regulation references requirements for manufacturing management and quality control of medical devices and in vitro diagnostic reagents. This implies a review process related to product requirements, aligning with the intent of ISO 7.2.2.

7.2.2.english_translation: Based on the provisions of Article 14, Paragraph 2, Item 4 and Article 19-2, Paragraph 5 which applies mutatis mutandis Article 14, Paragraph 2, Item 4 of the Pharmaceutical Affairs Act (Law No. 145 of 1955), this ordinance regarding the standards for manufacturing management and quality control of medical devices and in vitro diagnostic reagents is stipulated as follows.
